Their old quotes held the pipe characters of a shell `or` operator. The new quotes are parts of the same lines without that operator, so a checker must test that the quote is contained in the line. The term `model input files` means the two scripts `bin/ci/prime_hf_models.py` and `bin/ci/hf_cache.py`. The rows now say so. Open decisions for the next step. GH_TOKEN is defined by the GitHub CLI and stays in the group `github-actions`, as only CI workflows and CI scripts use it. GHCRTS says `reads`: no TRON source line reads it, and the GHC runtime inside `ingest` and `ingest-tests` reads it. CROSS_COMPILE and EXTRA_CFLAGS belong to the iotools makefile in `bin/iotools-1.5`, which no TRON build file runs. FETCHCONTENT_FULLY_DISCONNECTED stays a row: a Nix build phase exports it, and nothing in the checkout reads the environment form. A row says `reads` when only test files set the name. Script names such as `bench-refresh-ci.sh` are defined in `new_terms` and not in every cell, to keep the word limits. New terms added here: `pass marker`, `test_runtime.py`, `benchmark_runtime.py`.
